description: Turn a photo or illustration into pixel art: shrink it to a pixel grid, reduce it to a few colours (or a named palette) and save a PNG. Accepts a local PNG/JPEG path or an http(s) URL.

colors.description: Number of colours when no palette is given

input.description: Path or URL of a PNG or JPEG image

output.description: Where to save the PNG (defaults next to the input)

palette.description: Palette name (pico-8, sweetie-16, endesga-32, game-boy, 1-bit) or hex colours like "#1a1c2c,#5d275d"

scale.description: Upscale factor for the saved PNG, nearest neighbour (e.g. 8 for a crisp preview)

width.description: Width of the pixel grid in pixels (height keeps the aspect ratio)

name: pixelate_image
title: Image to pixel art
